Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِيْ فِيْهِ فَضْلَ لَيْلَةِ القَدْرِ
Translation: O Allah, grant me in this (month) the blessing of the Night of Decree (Laylatul Qadr)

Arabic text: وَصَيِّرْ أُمُورِ فِيْهِ مِنَ العُسْرِ إِلَى اليُسْرِ
Translation: And change my affairs in it from difficulty to ease
And remove from me the sins and burdens
O You who is kind to His righteous servants
